lede: I build software experiments that help humans and machines understand complexity and make better decisions.

stance.title: The information is usually already there.
paragraphs: In documents. Databases. Sensors. Numbers. Human experiences.
The challenge is not always collecting more information — it is connecting the dots, revealing patterns, and creating systems that make complexity understandable.

This site is where I explore that idea through writing and projects: knowledge as an engineered asset, structure before intelligence, and deterministic systems where probabilistic approaches need stronger foundations.
